raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Software Development Team Lead Amdocs
03/2024 – Present
 Directed a team of 9 software engineers, mentoring them through the full software development lifecycle to ensure high quality deliverables and foster team engagement.
 Collaborated with the Manager to deliver accurate estimations, identify resource needs and assess risks.
 Led and represented the team in cross-functional discussions, building strong relationships with internal stakeholders
 Integrated a CI/CD pipeline for managing 25+ microservices that increased deployment frequency
 Designed scalable microservices leveraging various design patterns to optimize reusability and maintainability.
 Developed REST services for cross-platform integration, ensuring backward compatibility with legacy systems.
 Deployed containerized applications on Kubernetes clusters with automated scaling policies.
 Integrated Apache Kafka to enable asynchronous communication between microservices, improving scalability
 Leveraged Claude Sonnet 4 Agent to automate the writing, execution, and recursive debugging of JUnit tests across an entire module, ensuring 100 % coverage of both positive and negative scenarios.
 Administered code reviews and provided mentorship, enhancing code quality and reducing post-deployment hotfixes by 20%.
 Advocated for agile development practices, elevating team delivery predictability to 100% and project transparency.
Sr. Associate -
